arXiv:2402.01234v1 [cs.CL] 2 Feb 2024

Attention Is Still All You Need: A Revisiting Study

Emily R. Johnson, Kenji Tanaka, and Sofia Alvarez

Abstract
The Transformer architecture remains the dominant approach for sequence
modeling. In this paper we revisit its core components and analyze the role
of attention.

Keywords: attention, transformer, sequence modeling
